name: 600 EX Biopace double crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 667 g for the FC-6207 Biopace double reference with 170 mm arms and 52/42T rings, excluding the separately listed BB-6207. This is separate from the existing 672 g round-ring reference. The manufacturer drawing identifies the FC-6207 base assembly; the catalogue supplies the Biopace configuration and mass.
